Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 33 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 58 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Kavita - 28 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Nitin - 34 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rajesh stands in the living room. Neeta, Kavita and Nitin stand near him.]

Rajesh: "What lovely weather!"

[Rajesh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Neeta: "Oh wow!"

[Rajesh sips red wine.]

Rajesh: "Yes, all right."

[Rajesh drinks a beer.]

Rajesh: "Yes, of course."

[Rajesh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Rajesh (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Rajesh walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Rajesh: "That was such a fun day!"
